properties.description:
Detects use of the legitimate Windows colorcpl.exe utility with bitsadmin.exe.
Guildma (Astaroth) malware has been observed abusing colorcpl.exe to copy
bitsadmin.exe into a less-scrutinized directory before using it to retrieve
additional payloads.
Ref: https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/Colorcpl/
     https://isc.sans.edu/diary/29814
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "colorcpl.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "bitsadmin.exe"
